dbz.definition: Decibel relative to Z — radar reflectivity unit; higher values mean heavier precipitation.

cape.definition: Convective Available Potential Energy — atmospheric instability; high values favor thunderstorms.

pop.definition: Probability of Precipitation — chance a point sees measurable precipitation in the period.

virga.definition: Precipitation that falls from a cloud but evaporates before reaching the ground.

wind chill.definition: Perceived temperature accounting for heat loss from wind on exposed skin.

heat index.definition: Perceived temperature accounting for humidity reducing sweat evaporation.

dewpoint.definition: Temperature at which air becomes saturated; higher dewpoint = more moisture.

relative humidity.definition: Water vapor in the air as a percentage of the maximum it can hold at that temperature.

wind shear.definition: Change in wind speed or direction with height; affects storm intensity.

pressure.definition: Atmospheric pressure, in millibars or inches of mercury.

visibility.definition: How far one can see horizontally; reduced by fog, precipitation, haze.

gust.definition: A brief spike in wind speed.

advisory.definition: NWS alert for weather that causes inconvenience but isn't dangerous.

watch.definition: NWS alert for conditions favorable for severe weather; be prepared.

warning.definition: NWS alert for imminent or occurring severe weather; take action.

outlook.definition: Extended-range assessment of expected conditions or hazards.

tornado.definition: A violently rotating column of air touching the ground.

hurricane.definition: A tropical cyclone with sustained winds ≥ 74 mph.

storm surge.definition: Abnormal rise of water generated by a storm, over and above tide.

almanac.definition: Historical climate averages used as a reference.

ceiling.definition: Height of the lowest broken or overcast cloud layer.

obstruction.definition: Anything blocking visibility near the surface (fog, haze, smoke).

haze.definition: Suspension of fine particles that reduces visibility and adds a milky cast.
